proceedings.outcome: property belonging to the applicant - the ship Stavanger and a floating drydock - was frozen
proceedings.supporting_quote: on 5 October 1995 property belonging to the applicant - the ship Stavanger and a floating drydock - was frozen on the order of the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office.

proceedings.outcome: the Stavanger was freed from arrest
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 19 January 1996 the Stavanger was freed from arrest

proceedings.outcome: the proceeds from the ship sale were frozen
proceedings.supporting_quote: on 11 March 1996 the proceeds from the ship sale were frozen on the order of the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office.

proceedings.outcome: the account was unfrozen and money transferred to the shipyard
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 18 May 1996 the Nizhniy Novgorod prosecutor’s office unfroze the account and transferred the money to the yard.

proceedings.outcome: applicant found guilty on some charges and sentenced to one and a half years in prison
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 21 April 1997 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on some of the charges, and not guilty on most. He was sentenced to one and a half years in prison

proceedings.outcome: conviction quashed and case remitted to the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: In July 1997 the Supreme Court quashed the conviction on the applicant’s appeal and remitted the case to the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court.

proceedings.outcome: motion for detention rejected as unsubstantiated
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 30 March 1998, during the new trial, the prosecutor applied to the court to detain the applicant... The Regional Court rejected the motion as unsubstantiated.
On 1 April 1998 the local electoral committee declared the elections invalid on the ground of irregularities committed during the campaign by some candidates, including the applicant.

proceedings.outcome: motion for detention granted and applicant arrested
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 2 April 1998 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court granted the prosecutor’s renewed motion for detention on grounds of obstruction of justice and violations of the undertaking not to leave the city, and the applicant was arrested in the course of the hearing.

proceedings.outcome: appeal against detention order rejected on grounds that national law did not allow separate appeals against such orders
proceedings.supporting_quote: The reply from the Supreme Court, dated 19 May 1998, stated that the national law did not allow appeals against that type of trial court orders separately from appeals against judgments.

proceedings.outcome: requests to dismiss judge for bias and to admit a new lawyer were rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 19 May the applicant’s “civil defender” requested the Regional Court to dismiss the judge presiding in the case for bias... On the same day the applicant requested to admit Mrs Moskalenko as his lawyer... Both requests were rejected by the Regional Court.

proceedings.outcome: applicant found guilty and sentenced to six years in prison
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 27 May 1998 the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court found the applicant guilty on charges of misappropriation and embezzlement, larceny, bribery and attempt not to return money from abroad... the court sentenced him to six years in prison

proceedings.outcome: issued several orders (частные определения) noting procedural breaches
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 27 May 1998 the Regional Court made a number of further orders ( частные определения ) in the case.

proceedings.outcome: ordered that the applicant should be given the amended version of the judgment
proceedings.supporting_quote: It appears that on 8 July 1998 the Regional Court ordered that the applicant should be given the amended version

proceedings.outcome: judgment confirmed with some alterations; sentence of six years upheld
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 10 August 1998 the Supreme Court confirmed the judgment of the Nizhniy Novgorod Regional Court, with some alterations... The sentencing of the applicant to a total of six years in prison was upheld.

proceedings.outcome: applicant's first (1982) conviction quashed and file closed
proceedings.supporting_quote: In February 1999 the applicant’s first (1982) conviction was quashed, and the file in that case was closed by the Nizhniy Novgorod regional prosecutor’s office.
